recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future work should revisit this only as part of a separate Bootstrap migration or a newly identified current responsive-navigation defect, not as remaining FHIR-2884 application work.
issue_request: FHIR-2884 was a Published FHIR-core Change Request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1, reporting that at lower resolutions the Bootstrap menu collapsed to an empty dropdown. The recorded resolution was to turn the affected dropdown markup into li tags so Bootstrap JavaScript populated the collapsed menu correctly.
initial_application: Jira comments say the issue was applied for DSTU1. No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-2884 appears in the current all-branch Git history, but the earliest Git-era newnavbar template already placed the responsive navigation content inside a ul.nav navbar-nav slot, and the current template does not contain the empty div-based dropdown structure described by the issue.
additional_context: tools/templates/newnavbar.html is included by many current source pages with [%file newnavbar%]. Later navbar source changes, including the 2022 Artifacts dropdown refactor and the 2025 Artifacts menu fix, changed menu contents and link behavior while preserving li/ul dropdown markup. Jira term search found only FHIR-2884, and Zulip plus Confluence searches found no conflicting or clarifying community records.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active template already has li entries for the collapsed navigation and an Artifacts li.dropdown containing a ul.dropdown-menu with li children, so a source edit would be redundant rather than corrective.
